title: Interleukin-10 Promoter-1082A/G Polymorphism and Idiopathic Recurrent Miscarriage Risk
brief_summary: This study aimed to assess the correlation between the interleukin-10 (IL-10)-1082A/G polymorphism and idiopathic recurrent miscarriage (IRM) of Chinese Han. A total of 100 women with IRM and 100 control women with a successful pregnancy will be included in this study. Then genotyping will be performed.
study_population: Female patients who referred to the Fourth Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University or Liuzhou Maternity and Child Healthcare Hospital
